rule: one marker per action = the lowest provider level PEMS 2024 prints for that action

rows.action: Follow Universal Patient Care / Initial Patient Contact
rows.pems_text: Follow Universal Patient Care / Initial Patient Contact protocol.

rows.action: Assess patient stability (chest pain, dyspnea, AMS, shock)

owner_ruling.ruling: EMR — any provider may assess stability.
owner_ruling.note: Owner ruling 2026-11-15: EMR — any provider may assess stability. No PEMS 2024 row badges this action; this is an owner decision, not a source citation. Do not cite p.135 for it.

rows.action: Obtain and transmit 12-Lead ECG
rows.pems_text: Obtain and transmit a 12-Lead ECG.

rows.action: Obtain IV access
rows.pems_text: Obtain IV access. Consider: ADULT: 0.9% Sodium chloride up to 1 L IV/IO in 250 – 500 mL boluses PEDIATRIC: 0.9% Sodium chloride 20 mL/kg IV/IO Repeat as needed to maintain adequate perfusion, up to 60 mL/kg total.
rows.note: Site label says 'A: Obtain IV access'; p.135#2 badge A. Site prints I/P (narrower by A).

rows.action: 0.9% Sodium chloride up to 1 L IV/IO (Adult) 250 – 500 mL boluses or 20 mL/kg IV/IO (Pediatric) Repeat as needed, max 60 mL/kg total
rows.pems_text: Obtain IV access. Consider: ADULT: 0.9% Sodium chloride up to 1 L IV/IO in 250 – 500 mL boluses PEDIATRIC: 0.9% Sodium chloride 20 mL/kg IV/IO Repeat as needed to maintain adequate perfusion, up to 60 mL/kg total.

rows.action: If rhythm regular, Adenosine (Adenocard) 6 mg IV/IO (Adult) or 0.1 mg/kg IV/IO (Pediatric, max 6 mg) Followed by 20 mL (Adult) or 10–20 mL (Ped) 0.9%
rows.pems_text: If the rhythm is regular, consider: ADULT: Adenosine (Adenocard) 6 mg IV/IO followed by a 20 mL 0.9% Sodium chloride flush. PEDIATRIC: Adenosine (Adenocard) 0.1 mg/kg IV/IO followed by a 10 – 20 mL 0.9% Sodium chloride flush. Maximum dose 6 mg. If no conversion within 2 minutes, consider repeating one time at double the initial dose.

rows.action: If no conversion after 2 minutes, repeat Adenosine at DOUBLE initial dose
rows.pems_text: If the rhythm is regular, consider: ADULT: Adenosine (Adenocard) 6 mg IV/IO followed by a 20 mL 0.9% Sodium chloride flush. PEDIATRIC: Adenosine (Adenocard) 0.1 mg/kg IV/IO followed by a 10 – 20 mL 0.9% Sodium chloride flush. Maximum dose 6 mg. If no conversion within 2 minutes, consider repeating one time at double the initial dose.
rows.note: Repeat-adenosine clause is inside p.135#3, badge I. Site label says 'I:' but prints P only.

rows.action: If rhythm irregular/atrial fibrillation, initiate transport Monitor for signs of poor perfusion
rows.pems_text: If the rhythm is irregular/atrial fibrillation, initiate transport to an appropriate facility. Monitor for signs of poor perfusion.

rows.action: Contact Medical Control for guidance Ensure 12-Lead ECG transmitted
rows.pems_text: Contact Medical Control if uncertain regarding rhythm, most appropriate therapy, and for guidance as needed. Ensure a 12-Lead ECG is transmitted.

rows.action: For light sedation, consider Midazolam (Versed) 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5 mg IN/IM (Adult) 0.05 mg/kg IV/IO or 0.1 mg/kg IM (Pediatric) Max: 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5
rows.pems_text: For light sedation, if time and patient condition permit, consider: ADULT: Midazolam (Versed) 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5 mg IN/IM PEDIATRIC: Midazolam (Versed) 0.05 mg/kg IV/IO or 0.1 mg/kg IM. Maximum dose 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5 mg IM. Monitor SpO2 and EtCO2.

rows.action: Monitor SpO₂ and EtCO₂ during sedation
rows.pems_text: For light sedation, if time and patient condition permit, consider: ADULT: Midazolam (Versed) 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5 mg IN/IM PEDIATRIC: Midazolam (Versed) 0.05 mg/kg IV/IO or 0.1 mg/kg IM. Maximum dose 2.5 mg IV/IO or 5 mg IM. Monitor SpO2 and EtCO2.
rows.note: p.135#5 (light sedation) ends 'Monitor SpO2 and EtCO2', inside the same badge-I row. Site row prints no level at all -> I/P.

rows.action: Perform SYNCHRONIZED cardioversion 100 joules initial dose (Adult) or 1 joule/kg (Pediatric)
rows.pems_text: Perform synchronized cardioversion. ADULT: 100 joules initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 200 joules. PEDIATRIC: 1 joule/kg initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 2 joules/kg. If cardioversion is unsuccessful after two attempts, contact Medical Control for guidance.

rows.action: If unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 200 joules (Adult) or 2 joules/kg (Pediatric)
rows.pems_text: Perform synchronized cardioversion. ADULT: 100 joules initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 200 joules. PEDIATRIC: 1 joule/kg initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 2 joules/kg. If cardioversion is unsuccessful after two attempts, contact Medical Control for guidance.
rows.note: Repeat-cardioversion half of p.136#6 (badge I); site I/P. Confirm.

rows.action: If unsuccessful after two attempts, contact Medical Control
rows.pems_text: Perform synchronized cardioversion. ADULT: 100 joules initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 200 joules. PEDIATRIC: 1 joule/kg initial dose If cardioversion is unsuccessful, check pad placement and repeat at 2 joules/kg. If cardioversion is unsuccessful after two attempts, contact Medical Control for guidance.
rows.note: 'If cardioversion is unsuccessful after two attempts, contact Medical Control' is the last clause of p.136#6, badge I. Site prints [P] only: under-grants I, and the bracket is not in the source. SVT's own MC row is p.136#7 (all MC).

rows.action: Airway management / Ventilatory support
rows.pems_text: Follow Airway Management and Ventilatory Support procedure.

rows.action: Assess Blood Glucose (treat < 60 mg/dL per protocol)
rows.pems_text: Assess blood glucose. If less than 60 mg/dL, refer to Hypoglycemia protocol.

rows.action: Obtain / transmit 12-lead ECG (STEMI Triage if indicated)
rows.pems_text: Obtain and transmit a 12-Lead ECG. If STEMI is identified, follow Administrative Policy - STEMI Field Triage.

rows.action: Obtain IV/IO (Humeral IO preferred if IV unavailable)
rows.pems_text: Obtain IV/IO access (humeral IO preferred if IV unavailable).

rows.action: Fluid Bolus: ADULT: 0.9% Sodium Chloride up to 1 L IV/IO in 250 - 500 mL boluses PEDIATRIC: 0.9% Sodium Chloride 20 mL/kg IV/IO (up to 60 mL/kg total)
rows.pems_text: Consider: ADULT: 0.9% Sodium chloride up to 1 L IV/IO in 250 – 500 mL boluses PEDIATRIC: 0.9% Sodium chloride 20 mL/kg IV/IO Repeat as needed to maintain adequate perfusion, up to 60 mL/kg total.

rows.action: Maintain MAP > 65 mmHg: ADULT: Norepinephrine infusion 5 - 20 mcg/min IV/IO OR ADULT: Epinephrine infusion 2 - 10 mcg/min IV/IO
rows.pems_text: Maintain mean arterial pressure (MAP) above 65 mmHg. Consider: ADULT: Norepinephrine (Levophed) infusion 5 – 20 mcg/min IV/IO (Add 4 mg of Norepinephrine to 250 mL 0.9% Sodium chloride = 16 mcg/mL) OR ADULT: Epinephrine infusion 2 – 10 mcg/min IV/IO (Add 1 mg of Epinephrine [1mg/mL] to 100 mL of 0.9% Sodium chloride = 10 mcg/mL)

rows.action: Pediatric SBP Support: PEDIATRIC: Epinephrine infusion 0.1 - 1 mcg/kg/min IV/IO *(Titrate to > 70 mmHg if < 1 yr, > 90 mmHg if > 1 yr. Max dose: 10 mc
rows.pems_text: Maintain age adjusted SBP. Consider: PEDIATRIC: Epinephrine 0.1 - 1 mcg/kg/min IV/IO infusion. Max dose: 10 mcg/min. Under 1 year old: Titrate to SBP > 70 mmHg Over 1 year old: Titrate to SBP > 90 mmHg (Add 1 mg of Epinephrine [1mg/mL] to 100 mL of 0.9% Sodium chloride = 10 mcg/mL) Note: Infusion via IV pump is preferred is available. Monitor closely for signs of extravasation.

rows.action: Bridge Therapy: ADULT: Push dose Epinephrine 5 - 10 mcg IV/IO every 2-3 minutes
rows.pems_text: To maintain MAP > 65 until a vasopressor infusion is prepared, consider: ADULT: Push dose Epinephrine 5-10 mcg IV/IO every 2-3 minutes (Add 100 mcg Epinephrine (1mL of 0.1 mg/mL) to 9mL of 0.9% Normal Saline = 10 mcg / mL)
